_note: Model chain per agent role, locked 2026-10-18 from end-to-end runs of the whole workflow (scripts/bench_pipeline.py, eval/bench_pipeline.json): 4 combinations x 2 simulated companies x 2 runs. This combination ('flash-lane') was the best: median 23 s for the high-risk company and 14 s for the clean one, 10.5 verified findings, 83% of source documents covered, rated high and low correctly, no fallbacks. First entry is the primary; each later entry is the fallback if the one before it is rate limited, down, or returns an unusable reply. Every chain ends on the free nvidia tier.

planner_writer.needs: Strong reasoning, long outputs, follows citation rules. Used by the planner, the drill-down planner and the report writer.

lane_agent.needs: Tool calling and exact quoting, fast. Used by the 4 lane agents (news, company, legal, science) and entity resolution.

verifier.needs: Strict judge of whether a quote supports a statement. Prefer a different model family from the lane agents so their mistakes are not repeated.
